CaseStudies.title: Results, not just screenshots.
CaseStudies.subtitle: Every project starts with a real problem -- here's how a few of them were solved.

case01.problem: Online bookings were nearly nonexistent -- most reservations still came by phone.
case01.solution: Rebuilt around a booking-first homepage with real-time table availability.

case02.problem: The existing site looked dated, which undercut credibility with higher-value clients.
case02.solution: Redesigned with a case-focused layout and clearer practice-area navigation.

case03.problem: Patients dropped off during the multi-step appointment request form.
case03.solution: Simplified to a single-step request flow with instant confirmation.

SuccessStories.disclaimer: Case concepts and metrics are representative composites based on typical project outcomes, not tied to a single named client.

story-hospitality.problem: A local hospitality business relied almost entirely on walk-ins and word of mouth, with no organic search presence.
story-hospitality.solution: Rebuilt around local SEO fundamentals, structured content, and a booking-first homepage.

story-ecommerce.problem: An online store's checkout flow and product pages were slow enough to visibly hurt conversion on mobile.
story-ecommerce.solution: Rebuilt the storefront on a modern stack with image optimization and a streamlined checkout.

story-saas.problem: Inbound leads were manually copied between a contact form, spreadsheet, and email -- with regular drop-offs.
story-saas.solution: Automated the full intake-to-CRM pipeline with routing rules and instant follow-up emails.
